plugins.name: Arcade
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Four games for the corner of your screen: Mate Factory (build a Mate-making business), Rooftop Run (parkour), Desk Defense (24 towers with 3 upgrade paths each, 6 desks) and Sword Quest (an open-world adventure). Games pause when you hide DeskMate. Needs DeskMate 1.8 or newer.

plugins.name: Calculator
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: A calculator with history, plus a unit converter for length, weight, temperature, speed, data, time and live currency rates.

plugins.name: Claude
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: See what Claude Code did since you last checked, watch a conversation with the status dots, and reply in the background.

plugins.name: Clipboard
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Your last 50 copied texts, searchable. Click to copy again, pin the ones you reuse. History is kept in memory only and never includes passwords copied from the Vault. Needs DeskMate 1.6 or newer.

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Sign in with Google to see new emails, get notified when mail arrives, and copy sign-in codes the moment they land. Read-only. Needs DeskMate 1.1 or newer.

plugins.name: Notes
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Quick notes and a to-do list, saved on your PC. Search your notes, pin the important ones, tick off tasks.

plugins.name: PC Monitor
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Live CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network usage with a short history graph. Shows GPU temperature and VRAM on NVIDIA cards. Needs DeskMate 1.6 or newer.

plugins.name: Schedule I
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Schedule I mixer, effects and ingredient reference, plus notes on the special customer groups (location, favorite drugs, best mixes).

plugins.name: Timers
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Quick timers and reminders with Windows notifications, so you don't have to leave your game to keep track of time.

plugins.name: Wallet
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: A crypto wallet for Bitcoin, Ethereum (plus USDC, USDT, DAI, WBTC) and Solana (plus USDC and other tokens). Create one or import your recovery phrase. Your phrase stays encrypted inside DeskMate, and every send is approved in DeskMate's own window. Needs DeskMate 1.7 or newer.

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.author: Lapis Studios
plugins.description: Current weather, the next 12 hours and a 7-day forecast for cities you type in. Never uses your device location.
